_why: The release the deploy ritual INTENDS to produce, recorded independently of the injection. build-release.mjs derived its expectation from inj.generatedFrom.rcSha — i.e. from the very file under suspicion — so a stale or reverted injection was self-certifying: the build succeeded and quietly emitted the OLD client, and the selector then handed it over as 'the release'. Found 2026-07-30 by FIX003-PIPE-06, which put a real .348 injection back and watched the build report success. Changing the release now takes TWO edits in one reviewed commit: the injection and this file.
